content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What are the four main OOPs principles and how are they implemented in Ruby?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Object-Oriented Programming in Ruby revolves around four core principles: Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism, and Abstraction, which help organize code into reusable and maintainable structures."}]
